## Testing

<!-- Tests were written first and seen failing; say which ones. -->

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests (unit, integration against the test server, or type tests)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the squash commit and the changelog line)
- [ ] README / CLAUDE.md updated when behaviour or API changed
- [ ] No `any`; casts through `unknown` only for deliberately invalid test input
- [ ] Bundle sizes checked (`npm run size`)
